featured_reviews.name: Sagar Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ Five-Star Review for Mr. Rahul Talekar & Team ⭐

We recently hired Mr. Rahul Talekar and his talented team for my daughter’s birthday celebration, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! From the moment he arrived (right on time!) until the very end of the event, Rahul was completely dedicated — capturing every special moment without missing a beat. He didn’t just “do the job”; he went above and beyond to make sure nothing was overlooked.

His photography skills are truly exceptional — whether it’s stunning portrait shots, lively candid moments, detailed close-ups, wide-angle group captures, or beautifully framed action shots, every click reflects his passion and eye for perfection. The videos and highlight reels he delivered were equally impressive — crisp, well-edited, and full of life.

One feature I absolutely loved was the face-recognition search in the photo gallery he shared — making it super easy for guests to find their own pictures. It’s small details like these that set him apart.

Rahul delivers exactly what he promises — and often more. His professionalism, creativity, and friendly approach make the whole experience effortless and enjoyable. Without a doubt, I’ll be hiring him for all my future events, and I’ll gladly recommend him to all my friends and family.

Thank you, Rahul & team, for making our celebration unforgettable! 📸🎉

featured_reviews.name: Kavi JB
featured_reviews.review_text:
We honestly don’t know where to start with this amazing team! Dharshan and Megha were so accommodating with our needs and always advised us of what would work from their experience. They were so patient to get all the right shots, and didn’t give up, even when it was boiling hot under the Goan sun!

We absolutely love how the photos came out and have received so many compliments from all our friends and family. They didn’t just get shots of the main events and close family, they got so many amazing shots of all of our guests and all these little moments that we can look back at and feel the same way we did on the day of our wedding.

When we watched our wedding film and looked at the photos as a family, we had so many tears of happiness and feelings of nostalgia. They really captured every moment perfectly!

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Kabra
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a lovely experience working with the Ethereal team! Three things that I really appreciated about them was their timeliness at all events and in delivery of all the photos and videos; their professionalism in every interaction we had with them and their enthusiasm and vision during our events to get all the best shots and videos. The team at our events was really experienced, they knew what they wanted, and they executed it flawlessly. Our entire experience of working with Darshan and Meghna went really smoothly, right from getting in touch with them to our various interactions before wedding and post wedding for our edits. Will highly recommend them for any important event, not just the wedding.

featured_reviews.name: Mansi Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
I absolutely enjoyed the entire process with Ethereal for both my family weddings— right from how we communicated to how the team was present during every moment of both the weddings. Everything felt extremely smooth and easy with them.
The output was what really moved us. It was something we didn’t expect at all, and it turned out to be so perfect we kept watching the films over and over again for newer emotions that we may have missed in the first glance and each time we were in absolute awe!
Especially for Jay’s wedding — that one was very close to my heart, and seeing the film really, really moved me. Ethereal met that entire emotion “seeing a brother being wed from a sisters eye” so well. There’s not one moment that has been missed anywhere.
From a photography point of view, it was exactly what I wanted and it was delivered!
You guys have a certain color tone that’s so consistent across the whole album, It has an editorial way of capturing images that’s real and can go on the cover of Vogue.
The imagery feels very fresh.
The framing is very natural and the moments feel real, not posed. It’s all very fresh and tack-sharp.
Even from the film’s direction point of view — it was done so beautifully. The way the moments and emotions were captured — it moves you to tears. The editing and the music were perfect.
All in all I have a great experience with Ethereal - Darshan, Megha and all the others, you guys make a fantastic team! More power to you!!!

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Jadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
We honestly loved both the photos and the videos. I still remember when we first met - you mentioned how your goal is to capture the true emotions and vibe of the event, and you really did just that.

We also really appreciated how you stayed true to your style but still made adjustments based on what we wanted. Every detail we asked for - the film length, the extra deliverables - you incorporated it all. And working with you guys was super chill, I felt really comfortable the whole time. Plus, considering how there’s never enough time during such events, we loved how you still made the most of the time you guys had.

Honestly, I don’t have a single negative thing to say. I’d definitely recommend you to friends! Also we loved our coffee table book by the way.

A big thank you to Darshan, Megha, and the entire Ethereal team for making our wedding memories so beautiful. ❤️

-Pooja & Nihal

featured_reviews.name: Arish Taraporewala
featured_reviews.review_text:
We felt like the stars of the day, with your team being incredibly attentive and mindful of our comfort and needs. The little nudges you gave us when we got awkward stood out, your team even joined in on the silliness of posing, and yet the end result looked absolutely amazing. When we first saw the photos and film, our reaction was simply “Wow!” It instantly transported us back to that day, letting us relive the joy and excitement. A big thank you to Darshan & the entire team at Ethereal Studio! 🙌

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Parashar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I found Ethereal Studios on Instagram while looking for wedding photography that felt natural and candid, nothing staged or over the top. Their work stood out to me instantly. They have a way of capturing both simplicity and grandeur without losing the soul of what wedding photography should be: timeless, heartfelt, and a true reflection of the beginning of a family’s story.

Darshan and Megha went above and beyond from the very start. They understood that we wanted a small, intimate wedding and approached it with such sensitivity and discretion. They took the time to really understand our brief, understand our story, listened to our requests, and brought so much excitement and care to capturing the essence of our Vrindavan ceremony.

Six months later, these photos are all the memories I have of my wedding day, and they bring me so much joy. They take me right back to those moments because they are completely unstaged and captured exactly as they unfolded.

On the day they blended into the wedding so naturally that it felt like they were part of our guests. Darshan’s warmth, curiosity,  and attention to detail meant we could be completely present and trust him to capture everything. Friends and family always comment on how candid and beautiful the photos are, and how they reflect the spirituality, simplicity, and emotion of the day.

I am so grateful to Darshan and Megha for giving us these priceless memories and for becoming friends in the process.

featured_reviews.name: Krishna Vora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Darshan and his team at Ethereal Studio were an absolute dream to work with. I hired them for my wedding, and I can't express enough gratitude for the incredible experience they provided. The team was so warm and loving, and the photos and videos far exceeded our expectations. We couldn't have chosen a better studio to capture our special day.

I highly recommend them for any of your events or functions!

A big big thank you to the entire team for making our day even more special.

featured_reviews.name: ravyanshi mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Firstly, thank you for covering our wedding so beautifully. You guys did a wonderful job. Just watching the team navigate the space was amazing — the way you managed to get the angles you did while never being ‘in the way’ was so admirable. At weddings, photographers can sometimes feel like they take over the space, but with you it was the complete opposite. You gave so much thought to giving space, to letting things happen naturally, and still managing to capture it all.

One of my favorite things is how you captured not just us, but everything around us. My family’s expressions, the crowd, the pre-setup of the mandap — these are things I didn’t even notice on the day, but now they mean so much to me. There’s a photo of my mom and me exchanging a look, something only she and I would understand, and you caught it perfectly. That’s the essence of our relationship in a single frame. Those moments are priceless.

The tones and edits were also beautiful. They felt like memories themselves, almost like flashbacks in a film. I don’t know if you put presets on the images, but they worked wonderfully. The way you graded the colors, it made everything feel like a memory — the way flashbacks look in cinema. Not the usual black and white, but something richer, almost cinematic. It was beautiful, because it made me think of my own memories in that same way.

I feel like a lot of good photography comes from a good place. The team didn’t just do justice to the fact that you’re making a living from this, but you truly wanted to capture the essence of the day. And that comes across in the photographs.

Like I said, I wanted it to feel real. I wanted it to be more in the action of it rather than posed. I remember telling you during our brief that I wanted it to feel like Mom and Dad’s or even my grandparents’ wedding albums, when they didn’t know what was going on, they were just present, doing the rituals. Those old photographs are so genuine. You see the scared look on my grandmother’s face, or my parents’ faces as they tried to focus on the ceremony under all that family pressure. That’s the kind of authenticity I wanted.

I didn’t want staged or curated images. I didn’t want to be told ‘look up while you’re doing this.’ I wanted to be present, and for the images to reflect that. And you gave me exactly that. A lot of the photographs you captured feel like memories — like when you shot just our hands, or the fire, or the priests preparing the setup. That’s what I was staring at, that’s what I remember. So when I look at those pictures now, I feel like I’m back there, living it again.
Even the things I couldn’t see — like the expressions on my parents’ or brother’s faces, or my dad’s excitement in the background — you caught those perfectly. I wasn’t aware of them at the time, but now I can treasure them forever. That’s what makes these photographs so special.

featured_reviews.name: Nishant Maloo
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful experience with Payal Gudhaka Photography for our baby’s one-month photo shoot! From the moment we stepped into her beautifully set-up studio, we felt a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Payal is not only highly professional but also incredibly patient and gentle, which is so important when working with newborns.

Our little one woke up a couple of times during the shoot, and Payal handled it with such ease and care, helping us calm her down while ensuring the session remained smooth and enjoyable. Her ability to work with babies is truly remarkable, and it’s evident that she understands their needs and comfort.

Her collection of props and backdrops is fantastic, adding an extra charm to every shot. She paid great attention to detail, ensuring that each frame was picture-perfect. The final images were simply adorable—each one capturing our baby’s innocence and sweetness so beautifully. Our family and friends absolutely loved the photos, and we couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out!

If you’re looking for a talented, patient, and passionate newborn photographer, we highly recommend Payal Gudhaka. She made this experience so special for us, and we will cherish these pictures forever!

featured_reviews.name: Zinal Patwa
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently did a maternity shoot with Payal and am totally in love with the results. She is so lovely and hardworking, she makes you feel comfortable and made the whole world experience enjoyable. The images are stunning and I will cherish them forever. I highly recommend Payal Gudhaka photography to anyone looking for memorable and beautiful maternity photoshoot.

featured_reviews.name: Suruchi Kundalwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We planned my baby girl’s photoshoot with Payal, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I first discovered her on Instagram, and the moment I reached out, I instantly felt I was in the right hands. Her warmth, professionalism, and the way she guided me with references made me so comfortable and confident.

The day of the shoot was truly magical. Everything just flowed so naturally—no stress, no rush—just pure joy. Payal was so gentle and patient, and she captured my little one in the most beautiful, timeless way. When I saw the pictures, my heart was full. These are memories I will cherish for a lifetime, and I am forever grateful to her for giving us such priceless treasures.

Thank you, Payal, for putting so much love into your art and for making this journey so special for us.

featured_reviews.review_text: I discovered Payal on Google while searching for a photographer for my newborn and energetic two-year-old golden retriever puppy. Overall, my experience with her was excellent, and I wholeheartedly recommend her services.
